coder_notes: Basket-type trial: IDH-mutant astrocytoma and IDH-wildtype GBM (NEO212 alone, Phase 2b) plus brain metastases from other solid tumours (NEO212 with SOC). Regimen coded monotherapy for the glioma cohort; the brain-metastasis cohorts are combinations with SOC agents listed as soc_backbone (given as the participants' protocol-approved SOC regimens). Biomarker rows other than IDH are cohort definitions of the non-glioma SOC cohorts and are matched to SOC agents, not the candidate. FOLFIRI split into three components sharing regimen_id FOLFIRI.
